anchor: the FROZEN SXT-028g Phaser model and its declared agreement threshold; NOT the pinned engine (no oracle in this environment)
claim_scope: controls only; no fidelity, agreement, support or listening claim is made or implied.

controls.control: NC-R1 convenient deterministic substitute for the RNG waveforms

reference_anchored_leg.reason: no pinned-engine fixture in this environment; the substitute must also be scored against the wet reference before any agreement statement. It cannot be: that is the finding.

controls.targets: a model that replaces the unpinnable RNG shape with a convenient deterministic one must be ADAPTED and refused from original-preset coverage
controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (the substitute renders, is materially different, depends on an arbitrary seed, is labelled ADAPTED and is refused from original-preset coverage)

controls.control: NC-R2 the fail-closed refusal is live and not always-firing
controls.targets: one rule, two enforcement points (frozen model + extractor); a refusal that fired on everything would prove nothing
controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (5/6 refused at both points, 0-4 accepted at both)

controls.control: NC-R3 silent exclusion (dropping affected presets from the denominator instead of publishing a reduction)
controls.targets: the coverage-impact tool must fail closed when the corpus it is counting against has been shrunk
controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (the silent drop is REFUSED and writes nothing; the untampered corpus is accepted)

controls.control: NC-R4 the characterisation's detector controls are live

detector_controls.check: DETECTOR CONTROL: two FIXED-seed constructions produce the same stream
DETECTOR CONTROL: the same shared generator with ZERO prior draws produces the same stream

controls.targets: a 'not reproducible' verdict must not come from an always-firing comparator
controls.verdict: CONTROL-OK (the fixed-seed comparators report IDENTICAL, so the FAIL legs are measurements)
